scope: source-derived finite weight-preparation service on defined iDMA platform projection; not native FlexGen AI deployment
experimental_platform: existing Genesys2/CVA6/four iDMA/RISC-V IOMMU/Linux; supported diagnostic uses same DMA/translation modules and behavioral DDR
source_object: complete OPT125m one-layer MLP package; 6 FP16 tensors, h768

physical_roles.DID10: iDMA source-image to relay fill proxy
physical_roles.DID11: iDMA relay to final operand buffer copy proxy

unmodeled_source_roles: source fill was CPU copy from a mapped file, not an observed storage DMA; neither role is an actual GPU or SSD here
demand_goal: all 6 tensor bytes visible in final destination, every offered job complete exactly once, final total drain; no deadline or token-rate threshold
ready: source images ready at common start; consumer copy only after entire matching source tensor fill done; all ordinary controllers get same readiness and tensor identity
buffer_budget: three independent 16MiB reserved regions; whole-package relay, no forced 4KiB single slot; PTE/DDT and software overhead additional
reachability: admit only unsubmitted register NEXT_ID job, after previous per-channel hardware done; never revoke offered AXI VALID

ordinary_baselines.rule: FIFO fill all chunks of current tensor; publish copy only at full-tensor fill completion; continue independent next-tensor fill while previous-tensor copy runs, each channel single active. Ready values immutable, full finite package and drain.
complete all finite fills, then all operand copies. Charge full first fill phase and queue/config/drain; source logical ready remains common start.

if the source is already translated DMA-accessible DDR as in this defined projection, same 6 tensors may go directly to final destination. Report same useful object and reduced copy/read/write bytes. No artificial ban on direct access.
ordinary_baselines.changes_source_DAG: removes optional relay; legitimate neighboring case, not evidence native SSD can be skipped

ordinary_baselines.rule: preserve legal 4KiB versus 2MiB whole reserved regions and fixed mapping/preparation costs, matched isolated comparison only for actual slowdown claim
ordinary_baselines.dynamic_map_unmap: not silently replace static Sv39 context with UVM/ATS/PRI semantics

ordinary_baselines.rule: At each real completion or free-channel event, poll/retire both lanes. If a whole-tensor-ready copy job and idle copy channel exist, submit the earliest such copy first; then submit the earliest remaining fill to the free fill channel. Re-evaluate after actual cfg transactions. Both channels retain one active job, original ready, original full package and final drain.
ordinary_baselines.information: completed job ID, idle channel, source tensor fill group completion; available equally to every policy
ordinary_baselines.parameters: none; source tensor order and four KiB seed partition fixed beforehand; whole tensor option not prohibited
ordinary_baselines.purpose: ordinary event-feedback dispatcher on this DAG, not old target170/p5 and not a new method

minimum_next_experiment: First define source-supported, independently useful finite AI transfer tasks whose work cannot be removed by skipping this optional relay. Confirm readiness, useful completion, mappings, physical-role projection and full costs; only then register a bounded ordinary-method G0. Existing rules and functional asset remain reusable.
entry_decision: Actual iDMA/IOMMU RTL functional conditions pass. Controlled transfer-stage experiments are technically possible, but current DDR-accessible source permits resident_direct and the original first fill was CPU memcopy. No native AI two-device mandatory-work or ordinary-method failure is established; do not automatically run the optional-relay performance matrix.
critical_costs: new task dispatcher and software supply rather than original full-batch hard-coded rings
CPU DMA ownership/cache flush and actual board task submission costs, not represented by diagnostic cfg
no source 8GiB pinned worker pool at zero cost
model DDR is not MIG timing; future matched source/image/clock/timing requirements remain
stop_conditions: source projection resident_direct covers need, so no two-hop-specific protection claim
ordinary policies complete object with acceptable tradeoff
translation-related wait cannot be distinguished on a useful completion path
candidate relies on excluding direct/preparation/large pages or inventing timings
actual source native application demand is required but unavailable: record evidence gap, not negative application result
